requirements.name: vulnerability research experience
requirements.source: - 2+ years of experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing or exploit development, or equivalent research (CTF competitions, published CVEs, open-source security work).

requirements.name: C programming
requirements.source: - Strong C programming skills and a working understanding of memory safety, the stack and the heap.

requirements.name: coverage-guided fuzzing
requirements.source: - Experience with at least one coverage-guided fuzzer and with sanitizers such as AddressSanitizer.

requirements.name: debugger proficiency
requirements.source: - Experience with a debugger (GDB, WinDbg or LLDB) and a disassembler.

requirements.name: disassembler proficiency
requirements.source: - Experience with a debugger (GDB, WinDbg or LLDB) and a disassembler.

requirements.name: Python scripting
requirements.source: - Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation.

requirements.name: fuzzing harness development
requirements.source: - Build fuzzing harnesses for parsers and network services using libFuzzer, AFL++ or custom tooling, and keep them running at scale.

requirements.name: crash triage
requirements.source: - Triage crashes, identify root causes and determine exploitability.

requirements.name: proof-of-concept exploit development
requirements.source: - Develop proof-of-concept exploits for memory corruption bugs (heap overflows, use-after-free, type confusion) to demonstrate impact.

requirements.name: reverse engineering
requirements.source: - Reverse engineer closed-source binaries with Ghidra or IDA to find attack surface.

requirements.name: web and API testing
requirements.source: - Test web and API front ends of client products when they are in scope.

requirements.name: findings report writing
requirements.source: - Write findings reports with reproduction steps, severity and remediation advice, and present them to client engineers.

requirements.name: modern exploit mitigations
requirements.source: - Exploitation experience on modern mitigations (ASLR, DEP, stack canaries, CFI).

requirements.name: kernel internals
requirements.source: - Experience with Linux or Windows kernel internals.

requirements.name: upstream vulnerability disclosure
requirements.source: - A history of reporting vulnerabilities upstream and seeing them fixed.
